suum visitantem exspectárant patres.
Considerate annos ætatis & ætatis. Id est gesta non
unius ætatis. Notat inconsiderantiæ vitium in progenie
perversa : præsertim in eo, quod ætatem cum ætate
non conferant : ætatem primam & suam ; atque utriusque
gesta in annis : quoniam prima redemptio ex Ægypto
cum ultima Christi magnam haberet analogiam ,
modo per umbram vellent cognoscere corpus.
Roga patrem tuum. Quidam hic singularem acci-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Hebrew word after "Hic" is read as עולם with [?]; "rerram" (read as rerum) is marked; "crudire" (possibly erudire) is marked; "feminis" (possibly seminis) is marked. Long s is printed as f in places (e.g. "fuiffent", "feculum", "ipfos", "elapfos") and is transcribed as s. The running head is set in capitals and is copied as ILLUSTRATUM. A small speck near the right margin is not text.
